list_cron_jobs: list all scheduled hermes cron jobs with their status, schedule, and last run info
list_cron_jobs_all: list all hermes cron jobs including paused and disabled ones
create_cron_job: create a new hermes cron job with a schedule, prompt, name, and optional skills
edit_cron_job: edit an existing hermes cron job by updating its schedule, prompt, name, or skills
pause_cron_job: pause a hermes cron job by its job id so it stops firing automatically
resume_cron_job: resume a paused hermes cron job by its job id so it fires on schedule again
run_cron_job: trigger a hermes cron job to run immediately on the next scheduler tick
remove_cron_job: remove a hermes cron job by its job id so it is deleted from the schedule
tick_cron_jobs: run all due hermes cron jobs once and exit
check_cron_status: check hermes cron status including gateway state and active job count
